description:
Position: Java Developer 
 Location : Cincinnati, OH / Mclean, VA
 Duration: Fulltime
 Interview: Telephonic/Skype
 Job Description: 
 Must Have Skills 
 Total experience of 7+ Years with 4+ Years in Java/ J2EE Development 
 Hands on experience of Spring JDBC template/plain JDBC integration 
 Hands on experience in Database Queries – PL/SQL – capable of understanding stored procedure and writing complex queries 
 Hands on experience in Maven build tool. 
 
 Other required Skills 
 Excellent coding skills in Java and Spring 
 Knowledge of XML and XSLT 
 Coding skills related to web services (SOAP and REST) 
 Code Repository – Clear Case / GIT (Should be able to check in, check out, merge branches, create baseline and promote code) 
 IDE – Eclipse, Rapid SQL, SQL Server 
 Project Build – Maven (Knowledge of building projects and resolving maven dependency issue) 
 Other Tools – WinSCP and Putty (Basic UNIX commands) 
 Demonstrated ability to create well documented code and documentation for team members and stakeholders 
 Demonstrated ability to build and deploy code in various environments 
 Experience collaborating with designers and back-end engineers 
 Experience working in an agile-like environment 
 Solid understanding of web/usability/accessibility standards 
 
 Graduates

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
